goals: identify save/load entrypoints and slot selection
determine serialized byte ranges and any headers/checksums/version markers
separate raw persisted bytes from load-time reconstructed/runtime-only state
document modding-safe persistent offsets only after binary proof
guardrails: do not infer persistence merely because a field lives in GameState
do not name checksum/slot/version fields until dataflow proves their roles
whole-ROM exactness remains mandatory for any contribution code

evidence: repo contains dedicated sram_proxy_1, sram_proxy_2, and code_lib_sram objects linked into retail ROM
ROM/library signature identifies SRAM implementation; exact proxy/library semantics traced separately
physical_medium.status: binary/source-layout anchored; save-slot structure still under investigation

header.valid_slot_mask: u32 at 0x20; verifier rejects bits outside low two bits; per-slot helpers set/clear bit 1<<slot
header.selected_slot: u32 at 0x24; verifier requires value <= 1; writer stores requested slot index

sram_geometry.guardrail: header field names describe proven behavior, not necessarily original developer identifiers

relative_layout.meaning: u32 serialized GameState byte count; writer stores 0x34F4 and loader requires equality to 0x34F4
u32 checksum = unsigned byte sum of the 0x34F4 GameState bytes modulo 2^32

primary_slot_record.checksum_helper: func_08011588(ptr,len): returns 0 for null pointer or zero length; otherwise sums each u8 into a 32-bit accumulator
primary_slot_record.save_order: size word, raw GameState image, checksum
primary_slot_record.load_validation_order: read size word and require 0x34F4, read raw GameState image, read stored checksum, recompute byte sum and compare

slot_tail_access_census.high_level_proxy_access: none; complete high-level proxy census has 17 calls, all addressing SRAM header fields or the primary slot record through relative 0x34FB
slot_tail_access_census.bypass_check: completed in Call6: direct low-level SRAM library callers and raw SRAM-address references were censused separately
slot_tail_access_census.conclusion: retail-unused by the identified save/SRAM executable: the per-slot relative range 0x34FC..0x3FEB is never touched by the high-level save proxy, no executable caller bypasses the proxy/library call chain, and no explicit raw SRAM address materialization exists outside the SRAM subsystem in the assembly source census
slot_tail_access_census.modding_note: 0xAF0 bytes per retail slot are therefore available as a strong mod-owned extension area while preserving the retail header and 0x34FC-byte primary record. Namespace/version custom data and do not assume compatibility with unrelated third-party hacks that may independently reuse this space.

executable_bypass_evidence.explicit_raw_sram_address_materializatio: none found in assembly source census
executable_bypass_evidence.raw_rom_word_scan: discarded as proof because arbitrary data produces numerical 0x0E00xxxx false positives
executable_bypass_evidence.proof_status: pass for the retail executable represented by this exact decompilation

serialization_abi.save_behavior: func_080115B0 serializes the complete GameState memory image verbatim rather than field-by-field
serialization_abi.load_behavior: func_08011650 constructs/reset-initializes a fallback GameState first, then successful loading overwrites all 0x34F4 bytes directly from SRAM and validates the checksum
serialization_abi.successful_load_postprocessing: after the raw payload read, only checksum/error handling occurs inside func_08011650; there is no successful-path field migration/fixup pass
serialization_abi.compatibility_consequence: retail save compatibility depends on exact GameState byte layout and serialized representations; changing the layout or serialized size needs an explicit compatibility layer
serialization_abi.failure_safety: the constructor/reset work before SRAM reads provides a valid fallback object when size/read/checksum validation fails
